clue.text: Learning from a newspaper about Rugby

indicators.note: the paper's issue is placed round, or about, the rugby abbreviation

parts.note: one printing of a newspaper is an edition
RU is the usual abbreviation for Rugby Union

explanation.surface: Someone picks up their knowledge of rugby from reading the sports pages.
explanation.definitionFit: Erudition is deep scholarship, the fruit of much study.

clue.text: It could help a poor Russian head off trouble

definitions.text: It could help a poor Russian

indicators.note: the word loses its head, its opening letter, cut off

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Something might spare an impoverished Russian from getting into difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head off' looks like 'avert', but it tells you to drop the first letter of 'trouble'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian currency unit is what a poor Russian lacks and would welcome.

clue.text: One of outstanding commitment

parts.note: read not as a devoted person but as someone whose obligations, debts, remain outstanding or unpaid

explanation.definitionFit: A person who owes money has an unpaid obligation, an outstanding commitment.

clue.text: Famed songster despite a throat infection

definitions.meaning: a well-known songbird
a fungal infection of the mouth and throat

explanation.surface: A celebrated singer performs in spite of a sore throat.
explanation.definitionFit: The bird is a celebrated singer, and the same name is given to candida infection of the mouth and throat.

clue.text: Laborious poetaster's exhortation to a tardy bud

parts.note: a poor poet urging something to open would write the archaic 'ope'
a late flower bud, here taken as a rose

explanation.surface: A bad poet laboriously urges a slow flower to bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces read 'Ope, rose!', a versifier's plea to a bud slow to open; 'ope' is poetic for open.
explanation.definitionFit: Operose is a literary word for done with great effort, painstaking.

clue.text: If a crime has been, the criminal should be

definitions.meaning: a crime is said to have been carried out, perpetrated
an offender should be sent to prison or for trial

explanation.definitionFit: A crime is perpetrated, and a criminal is sent for trial or to prison; one word covers both.

clue.text: Subservient state of last elite group

indicators.note: to group things is to arrange them, so these letters are sorted afresh

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A puppet state run by the last of the ruling elite.
explanation.definitionFit: A satellite nation is one dominated politically by a larger power.

clue.text: Accomplice gaining entry to a railway

parts.note: a means of entry is access

explanation.surface: A criminal's helper sneaks into a railway.
explanation.definitionFit: Accessary, also spelt accessory, is the legal term for someone who helps commit a crime.

clue.text: Patchy picture of Israelite leader

definitions.meaning: an image made of small pieces of coloured stone or glass
relating to Moses, who led the Israelites out of Egypt

explanation.surface: A patchwork portrait of an ancient Hebrew leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiles set in patches make a picture, and the adjective from Moses is spelled the same.

clue.text: An X put Thatcher there

parts.note: a cross on a ballot paper elected her; X is also the Roman numeral that names the address of the Prime Minister's residence

explanation.walkthrough: The Prime Minister lives at No 10 Downing Street in London; X is both the voter's mark and Roman ten.
explanation.definitionFit: The PM's official London home is known by its door number on Downing Street.

clue.text: Current claim by Englishman to be father of the French

parts.note: an English speaker claiming existence says 'I am'
pere is French for father

explanation.surface: An Englishman claims to be the father of the French nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The French physicist Ampere gave his name to the unit of electric current.
explanation.definitionFit: The ampere is the unit measuring electric current, so it stands for a quantity of current.

clue.text: Red-eyed and obviously feverish

definitions.meaning: with eyes reddened by inflamed vessels
read as '...', a plain sign of fever

explanation.definitionFit: Inflamed eyes are tinged with red; split into 'blood's hot' the word describes a high temperature.

clue.text: Supporters of men who want to walk tall

definitions.text: Supporters of men who want to walk tall

parts.words: Supporters of men who want to walk tall
parts.note: not backers but the long poles that physically raise a walker high

explanation.definitionFit: Long poles with footrests lift their user well above the ground.

clue.text: The art of cutting a fine figure

definitions.text: The art of cutting a fine figure

parts.words: The art of cutting a fine figure
parts.note: not looking elegant but literally carving a handsome figure from stone or wood

explanation.definitionFit: Carving or chiselling statues is the craft of shaping figures.

clue.text: March is a lively occasion

definitions.meaning: a military marching pace
read as a fast-moving, merry time

explanation.surface: The month of March brings a lively celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: The brisk standard marching pace has this name, and the words also describe a fast, lively spell.

clue.text: Find 19 across and win a trick

definitions.meaning: find fortitude, summon one's nerve
in card games, to capture a card of the red suit with the heart symbol

explanation.surface: Discover bravery and come out on top in a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: To summon courage is an idiom for being encouraged, and capturing a card of that suit in a trick is literally the same phrase.

clue.text: Set back for an understanding member

indicators.note: the word is read backwards, set back

parts.note: to set like jelly is to gel

explanation.surface: Someone is put back in place for being a sympathetic colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'an understanding member' is a limb you stand on, one that is under you.
explanation.definitionFit: A limb is a member of the body, and it 'understands' in the jokey sense of standing beneath you.

clue.text: Went ahead in a sledge

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone takes the lead while riding on a sled.
explanation.definitionFit: To be at the front is to have gone ahead of others.

clue.text: Gun warranting follow up

indicators.note: in a down entry the word is read upwards, so reversed

parts.note: to tag along is to follow

explanation.surface: A weapon justifies taking further action.
explanation.walkthrough: Gat is old American slang for a pistol.
explanation.definitionFit: Gat is gangster slang for a handgun, from Gatling.

clue.text: Imprisoned by bars our fortitude shows

indicators.note: one word is held inside the enclosure the other makes

parts.note: a cage is made of bars
taken as written

explanation.surface: Even behind bars, our strength of character is evident.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravery in the face of hardship is courage.

clue.text: Perhaps he is not so bad as 8

definitions.text: Perhaps he is not so bad
definitions.meaning: read as 'a better' person, an improvement on someone
the accomplice of 8 down

explanation.definitionFit: One who aids a crime is an accomplice, and split as 'a better' it describes someone less wicked.

clue.text: Spot what little I should carry

definitions.meaning: a small mark or point
the small mark above a lower-case i

explanation.definitionFit: A tiny mark is a point, and the lower-case letter i carries one over its stem.

clue.text: He who lacks one is nothing but a mere cog in the works

definitions.text: He who lacks one is nothing but a mere cog in the works

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
a pinion is a small cogwheel

explanation.surface: A person without views of their own is just a cog in the machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A view held is an opinion, and someone with none is just a cog obeying the machine.

clue.text: Key to the cupboard

parts.note: something that fastens with a key and is a kind of cupboard

explanation.definitionFit: A lockable storage cabinet, as in a school or gym.

clue.text: Vacillating episcopal maxim?

parts.note: a bishop's diocese is a see
a saw is an old saying

explanation.surface: A bishop's wavering pronouncement.
explanation.definitionFit: Going back and forth, as on a playground plank, is wavering.

clue.text: Firearm requiring degree of education by one who employs it

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts degree
someone who uses a thing is a user

explanation.surface: A gun needs a qualified person to operate it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mauser is a German make of rifle or pistol.

clue.text: What a woman puts on to effect a reconciliation

definitions.meaning: cosmetics applied to the face
to settle a quarrel, become friends again

explanation.surface: A woman puts on cosmetics to patch things up.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosmetics are applied to the face, and the phrasal verb means to be reconciled.

clue.text: Absent in body and in mind

definitions.meaning: physically very far off
daydreaming, not paying attention

explanation.definitionFit: Far off physically, or lost in thought; the phrase describes both distances.

clue.text: Rag-and-bone man is likely to if on his last legs

definitions.meaning: British slang for a scrap collector who goes round streets

definitions.text: is likely to if on his last legs
definitions.meaning: will wobble and stagger when exhausted

explanation.surface: An old scrap dealer is close to collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: A rag-and-bone man is a British street collector of junk, also called a totter.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrap collector is called this in British slang, and one near collapse would stagger unsteadily.

clue.text: Preliminary move in the nursery?

parts.note: a toddler's beginning at walking, and an opening action in general

explanation.definitionFit: An opening action is the initial stride, as a baby's earliest attempt at walking.

clue.text: Reassess a paper comment

definitions.meaning: to grade an exam paper again
an observation or statement

explanation.surface: Grading an exam again and adding feedback.
explanation.definitionFit: A teacher grading again does so a second time, and an observation is a passing word.

clue.text: Blizzards which blow in the spring

definitions.text: Blizzards which blow in the spring

parts.words: Blizzards which blow in the spring
parts.note: not storms but white flowers that bloom, 'blow', early in the year; read as falling flakes

explanation.definitionFit: These small white flowers bloom at the end of winter.
